support.fivem_installation: standard and custom paths; automatic discovery with interactive fallback
support.existing_plugins: isolated by default and restored transactionally
support.enhanced: not supported by v2 RC3; installer fails closed

modes.rp_visual: default launcher; standard signed ReShade + Main/Stream presets; no external ReShade add-ons
modes.full_neural: explicit launcher/Mode FullNeural; RTX 50-series + ReShade Full Add-on + SECRET EMKO-managed RenoDX/DLSS backends

support.multiplayer: server plugin policy applies; no Pure Mode, anti-cheat, server restriction or ReShade restriction bypass

renodx_framework.policy: latest upstream main at build time; exact SHA recorded in BUILD-MANIFEST.json

reshade.rp_visual: current official standard signed setup at install time
reshade.full_neural: current official Full Add-on setup at install time; explicit opt-in only

reshade_effects.policy: latest official packages required by shipped presets; unavailable external effects are disabled in installed presets

presets.note: Existing reshade-shaders content is migrated from the isolated old plugins folder; QuantV is never downloaded from unofficial mirrors.

dlss5_bridge.lifecycle: backend-only; no own settings overlay; cfg is live-reloaded upstream, and SECRET EMKO schedules it not to load next start when Neural Rendering is off

renodx_dlss5_consumer.lifecycle: file remains installed; SECRET EMKO soft-disables it at runtime and uses ReShade DisabledAddons so it is skipped on the next start when Neural Rendering is off

nvidia_dlss_nr.hardware_policy: GeForce RTX 50 Series; unsupported hardware rejected unless expert ForceNeuralStack is supplied

secretemko_live_control.safety: exact size + SHA-256 + code fingerprints + ImGui dispatch identity; refuses unknown builds
secretemko_live_control.behavior: SECRET EMKO unregisters the verified RenoDX settings page, applies supported values through RenoDX's own callback, and requests immediate callback readback confirmation
secretemko_live_control.provenance: MIT adapter derived from rakanki911/DLSS5-Swapper commit 24bd2aca7a7451ce94e564366381e33cac9dcdba
